Cyclotomic arithmetic: Q(zeta), zeta^2 + zeta + 1 = 0 (class CY); Gaussian rationals for the spinor
arrays; rational interval arithmetic on the PDG 2024 lepton masses; sin/cos by alternating-series bounds.
(1) Sign twist: for two 3 x 2 arrays W (rows: the three omega-spinors), relabelling the rows by any of the

    grid of (a, b), so the null vectors are exactly the two Fourier lines; Gamma f_+ is real only for Gamma = 0.
(3) Fourier coordinates: Gamma -> (Re(Gamma zeta^k))_k is R-linear of rank 2 into the plane sum d_k = 0;
    sum_k Re(Gamma zeta^k)^2 = (3/2)|Gamma|^2, so Q = 1/3 + |Gamma|^2/(6 a^2) and Q = 2/3 iff |Gamma|^2 = 2a^2.

    sign of Im Gamma (checked at the samples), and for the leptons 2 v_0 > v_1 + v_2 and v_2 > v_1, so delta lies
    in (0, pi/2), where tan increases; tan^2 delta lies between tan^2(0.2215) and tan^2(0.2225), so
    delta = 0.222.

from tp_premise import premise

# ---- exact helpers: Q(zeta_3), Z[sqrt 2], integer square roots, rational bounds ----
class CY(object):
    """a + b zeta with zeta^2 = -1 - zeta (zeta = e^{2 pi i/3}), exact."""
    __slots__ = ("a", "b")

    def __init__(self, a=0, b=0):
        self.a, self.b = F(a), F(b)

    @staticmethod
    def _c(o):
        return o if isinstance(o, CY) else CY(o)

    def __add__(s, o):
        o = CY._c(o)
        return CY(s.a + o.a, s.b + o.b)
    __radd__ = __add__

    def __sub__(s, o):
        o = CY._c(o)
        return CY(s.a - o.a, s.b - o.b)

    def __rsub__(s, o):
        return CY._c(o) - s

    def __neg__(s):
        return CY(-s.a, -s.b)

    def __mul__(s, o):
        o = CY._c(o)
        return CY(s.a * o.a - s.b * o.b, s.a * o.b + s.b * o.a - s.b * o.b)
    __rmul__ = __mul__

    def conj(s):
        return CY(s.a - s.b, -s.b)

    def re(s):
        return s.a - s.b / 2

    def nsq(s):
        """|z|^2 = a^2 - ab + b^2 (rational)."""
        return s.a * s.a - s.a * s.b + s.b * s.b

    def __eq__(s, o):
        o = CY._c(o)
        return s.a == o.a and s.b == o.b

    def __ne__(s, o):
        return not s.__eq__(o)

    def __hash__(s):
        return hash((s.a, s.b))


ZETA = CY(0, 1)
Z2 = ZETA * ZETA
ISQ3 = Z2 - ZETA          # zeta^2 - zeta = -i sqrt(3)


class R2(object):
    """p + q sqrt(2), exact."""
    __slots__ = ("p", "q")

    def __init__(self, p=0, q=0):
        self.p, self.q = F(p), F(q)

    @staticmethod
    def _c(o):
        return o if isinstance(o, R2) else R2(o)

    def __add__(s, o):
        o = R2._c(o)
        return R2(s.p + o.p, s.q + o.q)
    __radd__ = __add__

    def __sub__(s, o):
        o = R2._c(o)
        return R2(s.p - o.p, s.q - o.q)

    def __mul__(s, o):
        o = R2._c(o)
        return R2(s.p * o.p + 2 * s.q * o.q, s.p * o.q + s.q * o.p)
    __rmul__ = __mul__

    def __eq__(s, o):
        o = R2._c(o)
        return s.p == o.p and s.q == o.q

    def __ne__(s, o):
        return not s.__eq__(o)

    def sign(s):
        """Exact sign of p + q sqrt 2."""
        if s.q == 0 or s.p == 0 or (s.p > 0) == (s.q > 0):
            v = s.p if s.q == 0 else (s.q if s.p == 0 else s.p)
            return (v > 0) - (v < 0)
        big_p = s.p * s.p > 2 * s.q * s.q
        lead = s.p if big_p else s.q
        return (lead > 0) - (lead < 0)


def isqrt(n):
    """floor(sqrt(n)) for an integer n >= 0 (Newton)."""
    if n < 2:
        return n
    x = 1 << ((n.bit_length() + 1) // 2)
    while True:
        y = (x + n // x) // 2
        if y >= x:
            return x
        x = y


def sqrt_bounds(m, digits=10):

    m = F(m)
    scale = 10 ** digits
    lo_int = isqrt(m.numerator * m.denominator * scale * scale)
    lo, hi = F(lo_int, m.denominator * scale), F(lo_int + 1, m.denominator * scale)
    assert lo * lo <= m <= hi * hi
    return lo, hi

def cross_matrix(a):
    a1, a2, a3 = a

    return [[z, -a3, a2], [a3, z, -a1], [-a2, a1, z]]


def dagger(M):
    return [[M[j][i].conj() for j in range(3)] for i in range(3)]


def matmul(A, B):
    return [[sum((A[i][k] * B[k][j] for k in range(3)), QI(0)) for j in range(3)] for i in range(3)]


def norm2(a):
    return sum((x * x.conj() for x in a), QI(0))


def char_coeffs(M):
    """(trace, sum of principal 2-minors, determinant)."""
    tr = M[0][0] + M[1][1] + M[2][2]
    m2 = sum((M[i][i] * M[j][j] - M[i][j] * M[j][i] for i, j in ((0, 1), (0, 2), (1, 2))), QI(0))

           + M[0][2] * (M[1][0] * M[2][1] - M[1][1] * M[2][0]))
    return tr, m2, det


def shift(M, lam):

      so nu = m/H - (9/8) H/m + O((H/m)^3).

import GA
from tp_premise import premise

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Twistor core (shared text, ported from legacy/verify_T11.py Parts B-D; self-contained).
# CS = C^4 with basis e1, e2 (omega-plane) and e3, e4 (pi-plane); the ambient space is
# Lambda^2 CS in the basis e_i ^ e_j (i < j), with n_inf = e1^e2, n_0 = e3^e4 and the pairing
# <P, P'> = coefficient of e1^e2^e3^e4 in P ^ P'. Everything is over the Gaussian rationals GA.QI.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
from itertools import combinations as _comb

QZ = GA.qi(0)
QO = GA.qi(1)
PAIRS4 = list(_comb(range(4), 2))


def q(re, im=0):
    return GA.qi(re, im)


def eps2(a, b):
    """<ab> = a_0 b_1 - a_1 b_0."""
    return a[0] * b[1] - a[1] * b[0]


def wedge2(z1, z2):
    return [z1[i] * z2[j] - z1[j] * z2[i] for (i, j) in PAIRS4]


def perm_sign(perm):
    s, p = 1, list(perm)
    for i in range(len(p)):
        for j in range(i + 1, len(p)):
            if p[i] > p[j]:
                s = -s
    return s


def amb_pair(P, R):
    tot = QZ
    for a, (i, j) in enumerate(PAIRS4):
        if not P[a]:
            continue
        for b, (k, l) in enumerate(PAIRS4):
            if R[b] and len({i, j, k, l}) == 4:
                tot = tot + q(perm_sign((i, j, k, l))) * P[a] * R[b]
    return tot


def biv(i, j):
    out = [QZ] * 6
    out[PAIRS4.index((min(i, j), max(i, j)))] = QO if i < j else -QO
    return out


def vadd(*us):
    return [sum((u[k] for u in us), QZ) for k in range(len(us[0]))]


def vscal(c, u):
    return [c * a for a in u]


N_INF, N_0 = biv(0, 1), biv(2, 3)
EAMB = [biv(i, j) for (i, j) in PAIRS4]
X_SLOT = [biv(0, 2), biv(0, 3), biv(1, 2), biv(1, 3)]


def twistor(om, pi):
    return [om[0], om[1], pi[0], pi[1]]


def i_lam(lam):
    """I = n_inf + lam n_0 (lam = Lambda/6)."""
    return vadd(N_INF, vscal(q(lam), N_0))


def xslot(co):
    return vadd(*[vscal(q(c), v) for c, v in zip(co, X_SLOT)])


def xpoint(x):
    """X(x) = n_0 + x - (1/2) <x,x> n_inf."""
    return vadd(N_0, x, vscal(-amb_pair(x, x) / q(2), N_INF))


def on_line(co, pi):
    """The twistor (mu_x pi, pi) on the incidence line of x = (x13, x14, x23, x24)."""
    x13, x14, x23, x24 = co
    om = [-q(x13) * pi[1] + q(x14) * pi[0], -q(x23) * pi[1] + q(x24) * pi[0]]
    return twistor(om, pi)


def act(A, P):
    """A.(u^v) = Au^v + u^Av, extended linearly to bivectors."""
    out = [QZ] * 6
    for a, (i, j) in enumerate(PAIRS4):
        if not P[a]:
            continue
        Aei = [A[r][i] for r in range(4)]
        Aej = [A[r][j] for r in range(4)]
        ei = [QO if r == i else QZ for r in range(4)]
        ej = [QO if r == j else QZ for r in range(4)]
        out = vadd(out, vscal(P[a], vadd(wedge2(Aei, ej), wedge2(ei, Aej))))
    return out


def rot(U, V, W):
    """R_{U^V}(W) = <U,W> V - <V,W> U."""
    return vadd(vscal(amb_pair(U, W), V), vscal(-amb_pair(V, W), U))


def gsolve(rows, rhs):
    """Exact solution of a consistent (possibly overdetermined) system over Q(i)."""
    m, n = len(rows), len(rows[0])
    A = [rows[i][:] + [rhs[i]] for i in range(m)]
    piv, r = [], 0
    for c in range(n):
        p = next((i for i in range(r, m) if A[i][c]), None)
        if p is None:
            continue
        A[r], A[p] = A[p], A[r]
        inv = QO / A[r][c]
        A[r] = [x * inv for x in A[r]]
        for i in range(m):
            if i != r and A[i][c]:
                f = A[i][c]
                A[i] = [x - f * y for x, y in zip(A[i], A[r])]
        piv.append(c)
        r += 1
    if any(A[i][n] for i in range(r, m)):
        raise ValueError("inconsistent linear system")
    if len(piv) != n:
        raise ValueError("underdetermined linear system")
    sol = [QZ] * n
    for i, c in enumerate(piv):
        sol[c] = A[i][n]
    return sol


_UNIT_ACT = []


def _unit_act():
    if not _UNIT_ACT:
        for r in range(4):
            for c in range(4):
                A = [[QZ] * 4 for _ in range(4)]
                A[r][c] = QO
                _UNIT_ACT.append([act(A, EAMB[b]) for b in range(6)])
    return _UNIT_ACT


_SP = {}


def spin_preimage(U, V):
    """The traceless A in gl(4) whose action on Lambda^2 CS is the rotation R_{U^V} (memoised)."""
    key = tuple((c.re, c.im) for c in U + V)
    if key not in _SP:
        _SP[key] = _spin_preimage(U, V)
    return [row[:] for row in _SP[key]]


def _spin_preimage(U, V):
    ua = _unit_act()
    rows, rhs = [], []
    for b in range(6):
        target = rot(U, V, EAMB[b])
        for comp in range(6):
            rows.append([ua[k][b][comp] for k in range(16)])
            rhs.append(target[comp])
    rows.append([QO if r == c else QZ for r in range(4) for c in range(4)])
    rhs.append(QZ)
    sol = gsolve(rows, rhs)
    return [[sol[4 * r + c] for c in range(4)] for r in range(4)]


SIG = [[QO if abs(a - b) == 2 else QZ for b in range(4)] for a in range(4)]


def herm(zi, zj):
    """conj(zi)^T Sigma zj: the (2,2) Hermitian form pairing omega with conj(pi)."""
    return sum((zi[a].conj() * zj[b] for a in range(4) for b in range(4) if SIG[a][b]), QZ)


def moment(A, Zs):
    """M_A = i sum_i conj(Z_i)^T Sigma A Z_i."""
    tot = QZ
    for z in Zs:
        Az = [sum((A[r][c] * z[c] for c in range(4)), QZ) for r in range(4)]
        tot = tot + herm(z, Az)
    return GA.QI_I * tot


def gram_inverse(basis):
    n = len(basis)
    Gs = [[amb_pair(u, v) for v in basis] for u in basis]
    cols = [gsolve([row[:] for row in Gs], [QO if r == c else QZ for r in range(n)]) for c in range(n)]
    return [[cols[c][r] for c in range(n)] for r in range(n)]


_GI = []


def grip(Zs, I):
    """P = M(I): the ambient vector with <P, U> = M_{A(U ^ I)} for every U."""
    if not _GI:
        _GI.append(gram_inverse(EAMB))
    vals = [moment(spin_preimage(EAMB[a], I), Zs) for a in range(6)]
    P = [sum((vals[a] * _GI[0][a][J] for a in range(6)), QZ) for J in range(6)]
    assert all(amb_pair(P, EAMB[a]) == vals[a] for a in range(6))
    return P


def gram_h(Zs):
    return [[herm(a, b) for b in Zs] for a in Zs]


def internal_casimir(Z1, Z2):
    """C = (h11 - h22)^2/4 + |h12|^2 = tr(h_0^2)/2."""
    h11, h22, h12 = herm(Z1, Z1), herm(Z2, Z2), herm(Z1, Z2)
    return (h11 - h22) * (h11 - h22) / q(4) + h12 * h12.conj()


def casimir(Zs, basis):
    """C2(W) = (1/2) g^{ac} g^{bd} M_ab M_cd over the span of `basis`."""
    n = len(basis)
    Gi = gram_inverse(basis)
    Mm = [[moment(spin_preimage(u, v), Zs) if a != b else QZ for b, v in enumerate(basis)]
          for a, u in enumerate(basis)]
    tot = QZ
    for a in range(n):
        for b in range(n):
            if not Mm[a][b]:
                continue
            for c in range(n):
                if not Gi[a][c]:
                    continue
                for d in range(n):
                    if Gi[b][d] and Mm[c][d]:
                        tot = tot + Gi[a][c] * Gi[b][d] * Mm[a][b] * Mm[c][d]
    return tot / q(2)


def xreal(t, x_, y, z):
    """The real slice x = i K eps, K the Hermitian matrix of (t, x, y, z)."""
    K = [[q(t + z), q(x_, -y)], [q(x_, y), q(t - z)]]
    eps = [[QZ, QO], [-QO, QZ]]
    X = [[sum((K[a][b] * eps[b][c] for b in range(2)), QZ) * GA.QI_I for c in range(2)] for a in range(2)]
    return vadd(*[vscal(c_, v) for c_, v in zip((X[0][0], X[0][1], X[1][0], X[1][1]), X_SLOT)])


def in_su22(A):
    SA = [[sum((SIG[i][k] * A[k][j] for k in range(4)), QZ) for j in range(4)] for i in range(4)]
    return all(SA[i][j] + SA[j][i].conj() == QZ for i in range(4) for j in range(4))

TW = [
    ([q(1), q(0)], [q(0), q(1)]),
    ([q(2, 1), q(0)], [q(1), q(1, -1)]),
    ([q(0), q(1, 1)], [q(3), q(2)]),
    ([q(1), q(2)], [q(1, 2), q(-1)]),
    ([q(1, -1), q(2, 1)], [q(0, 1), q(1, 1)]),
]
PAIRS = [(TW[i], TW[j]) for i in range(5) for j in range(i + 1, 5)]
WS = [F(1), F(-1), F(-3, 2), F(2), F(-3), F(0), F(5, 3)]
LAM_SAMPLE = F(1, 2)                                     # sample lam = Lambda/6 > 0
MASSLESS_PAIR = ([q(1), QZ, QZ, q(1)], [q(3), QZ, QZ, q(-1)])   # sample Z1 = e1 + e4, Z2 = 3 e1 - e4
DOUBLED = TW[1:4]                                          # sample twistors Z for the doubled composites (Z, Z)


def check_dictionary_sign():
    premise("mass.mass-weight-dictionary")
    ok = True
    for lam6 in (F(1, 2), F(3), F(-1, 7)):
        Lam = 6 * lam6
        J = 2 * Lam / 3

def check_massless_locus_and_pure_residue():

    ok = ok and any(c != QZ for c in wedge2(Z1, Z2))              # not doubled: Z1, Z2 independent

# Exact characters of U(2) x U(3): a representation is a Counter of weights
# ((a1, a2), (b1, b2, b3)); irreducibles are products of Schur characters,
# computed by enumerating semistandard tableaux. Decomposition peels the
# lexicographically largest weight, which is always a highest weight.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


def ssyt(shape, n):
    """Content vectors of the semistandard tableaux of the given shape with entries 0..n-1."""
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(shape) for c in range(row)]
    out = Counter()

    def fill(i, T):
        if i == len(cells):
            cont = [0] * n
            for v in T.values():
                cont[v] += 1
            out[tuple(cont)] += 1
            return
        r, c = cells[i]
        lo = 0
        if c > 0:
            lo = max(lo, T[(r, c - 1)])
        if r > 0:
            lo = max(lo, T[(r - 1, c)] + 1)
        for v in range(lo, n):
            T[(r, c)] = v
            fill(i + 1, T)
            del T[(r, c)]

    fill(0, {})
    return out


def schur(hw, n):
    """Character of the U(n) irreducible with highest weight hw (entries may be negative)."""
    m = min(hw)
    shape = [h - m for h in hw]
    ch = ssyt([s for s in shape if s > 0], n)
    return Counter({tuple(x + m for x in w): c for w, c in ch.items()})


def irr_char(lam, mu):
    a, b = schur(lam, 2), schur(mu, 3)
    return Counter({(wa, wb): ca * cb for wa, ca in a.items() for wb, cb in b.items()})


def decompose(ch):
    """List of ((lam, mu), multiplicity) for a U(2) x U(3) character."""
    ch = Counter({k: v for k, v in ch.items() if v})
    out = []
    while ch:
        top = max(ch)
        m = ch[top]
        if m < 0:
            return None
        out.append((top, m))
        ch.subtract(Counter({k: m * v for k, v in irr_char(*top).items()}))
        ch = Counter({k: v for k, v in ch.items() if v})
    return out

    for S in combinations(cells, k):

def conjm(A):
    return [[A[i][j].conj() for j in range(2)] for i in range(2)]


def tp(A):
    return [[A[j][i] for j in range(2)] for i in range(2)]


def mmul(*Ms):
    out = Ms[0]
    for B in Ms[1:]:
        out = [[sum((out[i][k] * B[k][j] for k in range(2)), QI(0)) for j in range(2)] for i in range(2)]
    return out


def dg(xs):
    return [[QI(xs[0]), QI(0)], [QI(0), QI(xs[1])]]


def apply(op, vec):
    """op = list of (coefficient, mode, kind) with kind +1 create, -1 annihilate; vec {(k0, k1): QI}."""
    out = {}
    for coef, m, kind in op:
        for occ, x in vec.items():
            k = occ[m]
            if kind == 1:
                if k == KMAX:
                    raise ValueError("truncation reached")
                new, fac = k + 1, 1
            else:
                if k == 0:
                    continue
                new, fac = k - 1, k
            o = list(occ)
            o[m] = new
            o = tuple(o)
            out[o] = out.get(o, QI(0)) + coef * x * fac
    return {k: v for k, v in out.items() if v}

from itertools import combinations, permutations

from tp_premise import premise

Q0, Q1 = GA.qi(0), GA.qi(1)

          2: [GA.qi(-1), GA.qi(0), GA.qi(2, -1), GA.qi(1, 1)],

def faces(n):
    return [frozenset(c) for c in combinations(range(1, n + 1), 2)]


def composite(system, face):
    a, b = sorted(face)
    za, zb = system[a], system[b]
    return [za[i] * zb[j] - za[j] * zb[i] for i in range(4) for j in range(i + 1, 4)]


def bracket(system, face):

    return system[a][2] * system[b][3] - system[a][3] * system[b][2]


def embed(face, U):

    M = [[Q1 if i == j else Q0 for j in range(3)] for i in range(3)]
    for r, i in enumerate((a, b)):
        for c, j in enumerate((a, b)):
            M[i - 1][j - 1] = U[r][c]
    return M


def perm_matrix(sig):

Monomials in (Lambda, M_P, m, kappa) are exponent tuples of Fractions; H = (Lambda/3)^(1/2) (constants

from tp_premise import premise

def mmul(a, b):
    return tuple(x + y for x, y in zip(a, b))


def mpow(a, k):
    return tuple(k * x for x in a)


def rescale(mono):
    """Lambda -> kappa^2 Lambda: a monomial Lambda^l ... picks up kappa^(2 l)."""
    return mono[:3] + (mono[3] + 2 * mono[0],)


def weight(mono):
    return rescale(mono)[3] - mono[3]

N = mmul(MP, mpow(H, -1))

    ok = ok and (-(GA.qi(F(-3, 2), 1000) * GA.qi(F(3, 2), 1000))).re == F(4000009, 4)

    for a in EXPONENTS:
